title: 泰晤士河防洪閘~Thames Barrier
focus: 旋轉閘門力矩、河潮聯合作用與長期調適~Rotating-gate torque, combined river and tidal effects, and long-term adaptation
summary: 本課以泰晤士河防洪閘為入口，深入旋轉閘門力矩、河潮聯合作用與長期調適。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Thames Barrier as its entry point, this course examines rotating-gate torque, combined river and tidal effects, and long-term adaptation. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潮位2cosθ m、暴潮1cos(θ+60°) m，合成振幅√(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m，非兩峰直接相加3 m。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 另作固定姿態的敏感度比較：力臂維持1.5 m、淨重量與浮力矩−2 MN·m、摩擦矩0.5 MN·m，只把水壓合力4 MN改為5 MN。需求轉矩F×1.5−2+0.5由4.5增至6.0 MN·m，增加33.33%；這是獨立力擾動，不把它當作水位變動時力臂也固定的真實閘門預測。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume tide 2cosθ m and surge 1cos(θ+60°) m. Combined amplitude is √(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m, rather than the direct peak sum of 3 m. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. At the same posture, keep the lever arm at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment at −2 MN·m and friction moment at 0.5 MN·m, changing only water resultant from 4 MN to 5 MN. Required torque F×1.5−2+0.5 rises from 4.5 to 6.0 MN·m, or 33.33%. This isolated force perturbation does not predict a real stage change, which may also shift the lever arm.
history: 泰晤士河防洪閘以橫跨河道的活動閘門保護倫敦，與上游河流、兩岸防線及河口潮汐共同作用。泰晤士河防洪閘開始建設，進入河口大型活動結構施工階段。 泰晤士河防洪閘開始具備實際運轉防洪功能。 五月八日正式啟用典禮，與開始運轉年份有所區別。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。~The Thames Barrier protects London through movable gates across the river, interacting with upstream flow, bank defences and estuarine tides. Construction of the Thames Barrier begins, establishing the movable estuary structure. The Thames Barrier becomes operational for practical flood protection. Formal opening takes place on May eight, distinct from the operational starting year. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

units.anchor: 旋轉門體驅動力矩~Rotating-gate drive torque
units.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩~Rotating-gate drive torque
units.mechanism: 旋轉閘門的驅動需求來自重量、浮力、水壓與摩擦的合成力矩。各力臂隨角度改變，最大水壓不一定對應最大驅動需求。 假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。 密封摩擦、沉積物與軸承偏心會讓負載峰值偏離理想曲線。若只以平均馬達功率檢查能力，短暫的起動高扭矩和局部拘束可能被完全掩蓋。~Drive demand combines moments from weight, buoyancy, water pressure and friction. Lever arms vary with angle, so maximum water pressure need not coincide with maximum required drive torque. At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Seal friction, sediment and bearing eccentricity shift peaks away from ideal curves. Average motor power can conceal brief breakaway torque demands and local restraint that govern actual motion capability.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only.
units.verify: 沿轉角建立分項力矩曲線，對照油壓、位置與轉速資料；分開啟動摩擦和持續轉動阻力，避免只用終點水位解釋整段動作。比較起轉前後扭矩殘差，確認峰值是外載改變還是靜摩擦釋放造成的差異。~Build component moment curves against angle and compare pressure, position and speed. Separate breakaway friction from running resistance instead of explaining an entire movement by the final water level. Compare torque residuals before and after breakaway to separate changed external load from the release of static friction.
units.failure: 密封摩擦、沉積物與軸承偏心會讓負載峰值偏離理想曲線。若只以平均馬達功率檢查能力，短暫的起動高扭矩和局部拘束可能被完全掩蓋。~Seal friction, sediment and bearing eccentricity shift peaks away from ideal curves. Average motor power can conceal brief breakaway torque demands and local restraint that govern actual motion capability.
units.misconception: 最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。~Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque.
units.practice: 以旋轉門體驅動力矩編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿轉角建立分項力矩曲線，對照油壓、位置與轉速資料；分開啟動摩擦和持續轉動阻力，避免只用終點水位解釋整段動作。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rotating-gate drive torque, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build component moment curves against angle and compare pressure, position and speed. Separate breakaway friction from running resistance instead of explaining an entire movement by the final water level.

units.anchor: 暴潮相位與潮汐疊加~Surge phase and tidal superposition
units.title: 暴潮相位與潮汐疊加~Surge phase and tidal superposition
units.mechanism: 天文潮與氣象暴潮的峰值可能不同時到達。簡單線性相加可說明相位重要性，真實河口中摩擦與水深又使交互作用非線性。 假設潮位2cosθ m、暴潮1cos(θ+60°) m，合成振幅√(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m，非兩峰直接相加3 m。 取兩個不同時刻的最大值相加可能過度保守，也可能忽略風暴改變潮波傳播後的新峰值。模型驗證若只比最高水位，會漏掉危險持續時間。~Astronomical tide and meteorological surge can peak at different times. Linear addition illustrates phase effects, while friction and changing depth make real estuarine interaction nonlinear. Assume tide 2cosθ m and surge 1cos(θ+60°) m. Combined amplitude is √(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m, rather than the direct peak sum of 3 m. Adding maxima from separate times can be overly conservative yet still miss peaks created by changed tidal propagation. Validation limited to peak level overlooks the duration of hazardous conditions.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潮位2cosθ m、暴潮1cos(θ+60°) m，合成振幅√(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m，非兩峰直接相加3 m。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume tide 2cosθ m and surge 1cos(θ+60°) m. Combined amplitude is √(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m, rather than the direct peak sum of 3 m.
units.verify: 把不同來源水位換到同一時間與高程基準，檢查預報相位誤差；比較水深不同期間的殘差，以辨識線性疊加何時不再適用。對預報時間平移做獨立敏感度掃描，記錄峰值大小與超過評估水位的持續時間。~Convert water levels to common time and elevation references and examine phase errors. Compare residuals across different depths to identify when linear superposition ceases to represent the estuary. Independently shift forecast timing and record changes in peak magnitude and duration above the assessed water level.
units.failure: 取兩個不同時刻的最大值相加可能過度保守，也可能忽略風暴改變潮波傳播後的新峰值。模型驗證若只比最高水位，會漏掉危險持續時間。~Adding maxima from separate times can be overly conservative yet still miss peaks created by changed tidal propagation. Validation limited to peak level overlooks the duration of hazardous conditions.
units.misconception: 兩個不同時刻的水位峰值相加就是實際聯合峰值。~Adding water-level peaks from different times gives the actual combined peak.
units.practice: 以暴潮相位與潮汐疊加編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把不同來源水位換到同一時間與高程基準，檢查預報相位誤差；比較水深不同期間的殘差，以辨識線性疊加何時不再適用。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for surge phase and tidal superposition, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Convert water levels to common time and elevation references and examine phase errors. Compare residuals across different depths to identify when linear superposition ceases to represent the estuary.

units.anchor: 關閉期間河水蓄積~River storage during closure
units.title: 關閉期間河水蓄積~River storage during closure
units.mechanism: 阻隔海潮時，上游河流仍持續入流，受保護河段因此變成暫時蓄水體。可用庫容取決於沿岸高程與支流，不能只看閘前水位。 假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m；忽略側向溢流與面積隨水位變化。 只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。以平坦水面替代長河段水力坡降，還會低估某些支流交會處的局部水位。~When sea levels are excluded, river inflow continues and the protected reach temporarily stores water. Available storage depends on bank elevations and tributaries, not only the level beside the barrier. Assume net inflow 300 m³/s for two hours over effective area 20 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m, excluding lateral spill and changes of area with stage. Excluding the sea while overlooking a river flood can retain water inside the defence. Replacing a long river gradient with a flat surface can underestimate levels near particular tributary junctions.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m；忽略側向溢流與面積隨水位變化。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 300 m³/s for two hours over effective area 20 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m, excluding lateral spill and changes of area with stage.
units.verify: 用上游流量、支流雨量與多站水位建立同期水量平衡，檢查水面坡度是否仍可用單一儲水面積描述；另計未量測的側向流入。檢查各支流入流與儲水增量之和，量化忽略側向入流對上游水位估算的影響。~Build a synchronized balance from river flow, tributary rainfall and multiple water-level stations. Test whether one storage area still represents the water-surface slope and estimate unmeasured lateral inflow separately. Close tributary inflows against storage increase and quantify how omitted lateral inflow changes the upstream level estimate.
units.failure: 只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。以平坦水面替代長河段水力坡降，還會低估某些支流交會處的局部水位。~Excluding the sea while overlooking a river flood can retain water inside the defence. Replacing a long river gradient with a flat surface can underestimate levels near particular tributary junctions.
units.misconception: 關閘排除海水後，上游水位就不可能繼續上升。~Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded.
units.practice: 以關閉期間河水蓄積編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用上游流量、支流雨量與多站水位建立同期水量平衡，檢查水面坡度是否仍可用單一儲水面積描述；另計未量測的側向流入。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for river storage during closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build a synchronized balance from river flow, tributary rainfall and multiple water-level stations. Test whether one storage area still represents the water-surface slope and estimate unmeasured lateral inflow separately.

units.anchor: 通航窗口與排程~Navigation windows and scheduling
units.title: 通航窗口與排程~Navigation windows and scheduling
units.mechanism: 活動防洪結構同時是航運通道，通航窗口受水位、橋下空間與設備可用性約束。平均船舶到達率無法描述尖峰排隊與關閉後的復原時間。 假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。 若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。把通過閘區的時間與完整航段時間混用，則會錯算容量並掩蓋航道瓶頸。~A movable flood defence is also a navigation route. Windows depend on level, clearance and availability; average vessel arrivals do not describe peak queues or recovery after a closure. Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels. After reopening, service six and arrivals four per hour require 12/(6−4)=6 hours to clear. If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears. Mixing barrier-crossing time with complete-route time miscalculates capacity and conceals bottlenecks elsewhere in the navigation channel.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels. After reopening, service six and arrivals four per hour require 12/(6−4)=6 hours to clear.
units.verify: 用匿名化船舶到達與通過時間畫累積曲線，核對服務率是否受船型和潮向影響；將安全間隔和商業需求分列，避免把理論容量當保證。從累積到達與離開曲線的垂直距離求隊列，並核對復原斜率是否真正大於到達率。~Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate. Separate safety spacing from commercial demand instead of presenting theoretical capacity as guaranteed throughput. Derive queue size from cumulative arrival-departure separation and verify that recovery service genuinely exceeds arrivals.
units.failure: 若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。把通過閘區的時間與完整航段時間混用，則會錯算容量並掩蓋航道瓶頸。~If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears. Mixing barrier-crossing time with complete-route time miscalculates capacity and conceals bottlenecks elsewhere in the navigation channel.
units.misconception: 只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。~Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue.
units.practice: 以通航窗口與排程編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用匿名化船舶到達與通過時間畫累積曲線，核對服務率是否受船型和潮向影響；將安全間隔和商業需求分列，避免把理論容量當保證。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for navigation windows and scheduling, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate. Separate safety spacing from commercial demand instead of presenting theoretical capacity as guaranteed throughput.

units.anchor: 門槽沉積與淨空~Gate-recess sediment and clearance
units.title: 門槽沉積與淨空~Gate-recess sediment and clearance
units.mechanism: 下沉式門體需要特定運動空間，門槽沉積改變淨空與局部水流。平均淤積厚度不能代表單個硬物或高點，幾何檢查必須覆蓋整段掃掠體積。 假設槽底面積400 m²、均勻淤積厚0.08 m，沉積體積32 m³；若濕容重16 kN/m³，重量512 kN，不代表驅動附加力。 均勻沉積假設會低估孤立塊體造成的卡阻，移除沉積也可能暴露既有底板損傷。若只用挖除體積驗收，不能證明全部運動空間已恢復。~A recessed gate requires a defined swept space. Sediment changes clearance and local flow, while average deposit thickness cannot represent isolated hard objects or high spots across that volume. Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³. At wet unit weight 16 kN/m³, weight is 512 kN, not the added drive force. Uniform deposits underestimate jamming from isolated blocks, and removal can expose existing sill damage. Excavated volume alone cannot establish that the entire required swept space has been restored.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設槽底面積400 m²、均勻淤積厚0.08 m，沉積體積32 m³；若濕容重16 kN/m³，重量512 kN，不代表驅動附加力。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³. At wet unit weight 16 kN/m³, weight is 512 kN, not the added drive force.
units.verify: 用可重複定位的測深與影像核對槽底高點，區分鬆散泥砂和硬質異物；把門體掃掠幾何疊合測量面，保存清理前後差異。逐格比較測深不確定度與門體幾何裕度，對最接近掃掠包絡的高點安排獨立複測。~Use repeatable bathymetry and imagery to identify high spots and distinguish loose sediment from hard debris. Overlay the gate swept volume on surveyed surfaces and preserve before-and-after changes. Compare sounding uncertainty with geometric allowance cell by cell and independently resurvey high spots nearest the swept envelope.
units.failure: 均勻沉積假設會低估孤立塊體造成的卡阻，移除沉積也可能暴露既有底板損傷。若只用挖除體積驗收，不能證明全部運動空間已恢復。~Uniform deposits underestimate jamming from isolated blocks, and removal can expose existing sill damage. Excavated volume alone cannot establish that the entire required swept space has been restored.
units.misconception: 清出預定泥砂總量就能證明所有門槽淨空足夠。~Removing the planned sediment volume proves sufficient clearance throughout the recess.
units.practice: 以門槽沉積與淨空編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用可重複定位的測深與影像核對槽底高點，區分鬆散泥砂和硬質異物；把門體掃掠幾何疊合測量面，保存清理前後差異。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for gate-recess sediment and clearance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Use repeatable bathymetry and imagery to identify high spots and distinguish loose sediment from hard debris. Overlay the gate swept volume on surveyed surfaces and preserve before-and-after changes.

units.anchor: 液壓功率與效率~Hydraulic power and efficiency
units.title: 液壓功率與效率~Hydraulic power and efficiency
units.mechanism: 液壓驅動把流體壓力與流量轉成機械功率，泵的電功率還包含損失。相同壓力下流量不足會降低速度，不能只憑壓力表判斷動作能力。 假設壓差12 MPa、流量0.02 m³/s、總效率0.8，輸入功率ΔpQ/η=300 kW；穩定流量，未含加速與儲能器瞬態。 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。~Hydraulic drives convert pressure and flow into mechanical power, while electrical input also covers losses. Insufficient flow reduces speed even at normal pressure, so a gauge alone cannot establish movement capability. Assume pressure difference 12 MPa, flow 0.02 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.8. Input ΔpQ/η=300 kW, for steady flow without acceleration or accumulator transients. Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設壓差12 MPa、流量0.02 m³/s、總效率0.8，輸入功率ΔpQ/η=300 kW；穩定流量，未含加速與儲能器瞬態。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume pressure difference 12 MPa, flow 0.02 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.8. Input ΔpQ/η=300 kW, for steady flow without acceleration or accumulator transients.
units.verify: 同步量測油壓、流量、溫度和門位速率，比較液壓輸入與機械輸出；確認量測位置是在泵側或缸側，避免把管路損失重複計入。將能量差換算成熱產生量並核對油溫趨勢，確認內漏推論符合能量守恆。~Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output. Identify pump-side versus cylinder-side measurements to avoid double-counting line losses. Convert the power difference into heat generation and compare temperature trends to test the leakage interpretation against energy conservation.
units.failure: 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。~Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading.
units.misconception: 油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。~Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement.
units.practice: 以液壓功率與效率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測油壓、流量、溫度和門位速率，比較液壓輸入與機械輸出；確認量測位置是在泵側或缸側，避免把管路損失重複計入。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic power and efficiency, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output. Identify pump-side versus cylinder-side measurements to avoid double-counting line losses.

units.anchor: 防線接續高程~Continuous defence elevations
units.title: 防線接續高程~Continuous defence elevations
units.mechanism: 防洪閘與兩岸堤牆必須形成連續高程線，局部低點會繞過強大的主結構。水位基準、沉降與門檻高程的差異往往比平均牆高更重要。 假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。 主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。以地圖等高線代替接縫精密測量，會把繞流通道藏在資料解析度之下。~Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line. Local low points bypass strong main structures, making datum consistency, settlement and sill elevation more important than average wall height. Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Remaining geometric freeboard is 0.58 m, excluding wave runup and probabilistic margins. A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. Coarse map contours can hide bypass routes that require detailed joint and crossing surveys.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Remaining geometric freeboard is 0.58 m, excluding wave runup and probabilistic margins.
units.verify: 沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。對最低接續點進行反向水準複測，將量測閉合差納入幾何超高的不確定度。~Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings. Retain settlement rates and map versions to prevent mixing elevations from different surveys. Repeat leveling in reverse at the lowest connection and include survey closure error in the freeboard uncertainty.
units.failure: 主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。以地圖等高線代替接縫精密測量，會把繞流通道藏在資料解析度之下。~A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. Coarse map contours can hide bypass routes that require detailed joint and crossing surveys.
units.misconception: 主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。~Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence.
units.practice: 以防線接續高程編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for continuous defence elevations, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings. Retain settlement rates and map versions to prevent mixing elevations from different surveys.

units.anchor: 波浪脈衝與反力~Wave impulse and reaction
units.title: 波浪脈衝與反力~Wave impulse and reaction
units.mechanism: 波浪撞擊的峰值和持續時間共同決定脈衝，短脈衝對柔性構件的作用不同於同峰值的長載重。靜水壓力不能替代瞬態結構反應。 假設三角形力脈衝峰值2 MN、歷時0.4 s，衝量J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s；未由此直接求位移或疲勞。 低取樣率可能完全漏掉撞擊峰值，過度放大峰值而忽略面積與相位也會誤判總力。氣泡含量及局部接觸使相鄰壓力計不一定同步到峰。~Wave impact depends on both peak and duration. A short impulse affects a flexible member differently from a sustained load of equal peak, so hydrostatics cannot substitute for transient structural response. Assume a triangular force pulse with peak 2 MN and duration 0.4 s. Impulse J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s; displacement and fatigue are not obtained from this alone. Low sampling may miss impact peaks, while multiplying one peak over the entire area misstates total force. Air content and local contact mean adjacent sensors need not peak simultaneously.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設三角形力脈衝峰值2 MN、歷時0.4 s，衝量J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s；未由此直接求位移或疲勞。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a triangular force pulse with peak 2 MN and duration 0.4 s. Impulse J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s; displacement and fatigue are not obtained from this alone.
units.verify: 用足夠取樣率的壓力和加速度訊號核對脈衝形狀，查濾波是否削掉短峰；再比較脈衝歷時與結構自振週期，決定動力模型層級。用原始高頻資料重新積分衝量，檢查不同感測器峰值是否在同一時間真正重疊。~Check pulse shape with sufficiently sampled pressure and acceleration records, examining whether filtering removes brief peaks. Compare duration with structural natural period to choose an appropriate dynamic model. Reintegrate impulse from raw high-frequency data and check whether peaks at separate sensors actually coincide in time.
units.failure: 低取樣率可能完全漏掉撞擊峰值，過度放大峰值而忽略面積與相位也會誤判總力。氣泡含量及局部接觸使相鄰壓力計不一定同步到峰。~Low sampling may miss impact peaks, while multiplying one peak over the entire area misstates total force. Air content and local contact mean adjacent sensors need not peak simultaneously.
units.misconception: 一個壓力計的瞬間峰值能直接代表整門瞬時合力。~One sensor pressure peak directly represents the instantaneous whole-gate resultant.
units.practice: 以波浪脈衝與反力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用足夠取樣率的壓力和加速度訊號核對脈衝形狀，查濾波是否削掉短峰；再比較脈衝歷時與結構自振週期，決定動力模型層級。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for wave impulse and reaction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check pulse shape with sufficiently sampled pressure and acceleration records, examining whether filtering removes brief peaks. Compare duration with structural natural period to choose an appropriate dynamic model.

units.anchor: 檢測覆蓋與可用度~Test coverage and availability
units.title: 檢測覆蓋與可用度~Test coverage and availability
units.mechanism: 定期測試只能發現被測功能的故障，無法保證未施加的環境與荷載。檢測間隔與潛伏失效機率相關，但獨立恆定失效率只是基礎模型。 假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。~Periodic tests reveal only exercised failures, not untested environments and loads. Test interval influences latent unavailability, but constant independent failure rate is only a basic model. Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days. Mean unavailability is approximately λT/2=0.003, for small λT and complete detection. Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days. Mean unavailability is approximately λT/2=0.003, for small λT and complete detection.
units.verify: 列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。將未覆蓋的故障模式逐一對應替代證據，確認停機維修時間沒有從可用度分母中刪除。~List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment. Record discovery time, repair time and outage cause separately. Map uncovered failure modes to alternative evidence and verify that maintenance downtime remains in the availability denominator.
units.failure: 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。~Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate.
units.misconception: 一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。~One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised.
units.practice: 以檢測覆蓋與可用度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for test coverage and availability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment. Record discovery time, repair time and outage cause separately.

units.anchor: 海平面情境與調適~Sea-level scenarios and adaptation
units.title: 海平面情境與調適~Sea-level scenarios and adaptation
units.mechanism: 長期海平面變化會改變關閉頻率、河流排水窗口和維護時間，而不只提高一道設計水位。情境外推用來比較方案，並非保證未來趨勢。 假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。 以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。若只加高牆體而不評估關閉增加，設備疲勞和內河排水需求仍可能失配。~Long-term sea-level change affects closure frequency, drainage windows and maintenance time, not only a design level. Scenario extrapolation compares options rather than guaranteeing a future trend. Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m. An assumed acceleration 0.05 mm/year² adds 0.5at²=0.04 m. One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. Raising walls without examining more frequent closures can leave equipment fatigue and inland drainage demands poorly matched.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m. An assumed acceleration 0.05 mm/year² adds 0.5at²=0.04 m.
units.verify: 把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。比較各情境對排水窗口與關閉循環的影響，明列哪些變化先觸發功能重新評估。~Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios. Separate observed trends from planning assumptions and compare freeboard, drainage duration and equipment-cycle sensitivity across scenarios. Compare scenario effects on drainage windows and closure cycles, stating which changes first trigger reassessment of system function.
units.failure: 以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。若只加高牆體而不評估關閉增加，設備疲勞和內河排水需求仍可能失配。~One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. Raising walls without examining more frequent closures can leave equipment fatigue and inland drainage demands poorly matched.
units.misconception: 長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。~Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions.
units.practice: 以海平面情境與調適編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for sea-level scenarios and adaptation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios. Separate observed trends from planning assumptions and compare freeboard, drainage duration and equipment-cycle sensitivity across scenarios.
